# Amir Qaribi — Enterprise Software Engineer

> Official professional profile of Amir Qaribi (امیر غریبی), an enterprise software engineer based in Tehran, Iran. Specializes in C#/.NET backend architecture, enterprise business systems, SQL Server, Elasticsearch, document management, system integration, Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, and AI-enabled software. Software engineering experience began in 2017.
